name: Agent Common
subtitle: Deliver general project tasks
description: Agent Common structures and handles general project tasks from goal clarification to a verified result. The skills-only plugin uses existing files and sources, makes safe reversible assumptions, keeps clear boundaries for changes and external actions, and documents the implementation, the checks performed, and the remaining open points.
capabilities: Work general project tasks in a structured way
Evaluate existing files and sources in context
Implement and check authorized changes with focus
starterPrompts: Work this task independently through to a usable result.
Structure this assignment and make the necessary changes.
Review the existing project context and deliver the next reliable state.

brand.concept: Several open work lines converge into one clear closing hook.

note: Repository-maintained evidence format. This is not an OpenAI upload schema.
